# Skills

Short task guides for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot). Each folder has a `SKILL.md` that says when to use it.

| Skill | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `ledger-dev` | Bounded code changes with strict money and domain safety. |
| `ledger-ui` | Frontend conventions: app shell, adding a page, permissions, money display, mobile. |
| `ledger-docs` | Answering "how do I..." questions from the docs only. |
| `docs-sync` | Keeping the docs in step with code after a change. |
| `warden-commands` | Which Warden command to use for run, DB, accounts, demo data and deploy. |
| `d1-sync` | Backing up, copying and restoring the D1 database (live and local). |
| `safe-money-operations` | Migrations, backups, restores and role-sensitive changes, non-destructive by default. |
| `validate-workspace-changes` | Choosing the smallest useful tests and checks for a change. |
